title: Mock Product Overview
text: Welcome to MockFlow. MockFlow is a fictional internal operations assistant for platform engineers and application developers. It reduces context switching during technical investigation.

title: Architecture and Security
text: MockFlow uses a client-neutral MCP integration layer. Read-only operations are available by default, while mutating operations require explicit approval gates.

title: Roadmap
text: The roadmap includes richer image and document understanding, approval-aware workflow automation, more language choices, and stronger audit reporting.
